mapper.select: SELECT id, recovery_epoch, recovery_attempts FROM count_line WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND count_plan_id=#{planId} AND status IN ('OBSERVED','RESERVATION_CONFLICT') AND counted_qty IS NOT NULL AND recovery_attempts < 8 AND (recovery_lease_until IS NULL OR recovery_lease_until <= #{now}) AND (recovery_next_at IS NULL OR recovery_next_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY recovery_attempts, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO count_plan (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, status, reason_code, scope_version, approved_by, approved_at, approval_id, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{status}, #{reason}, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO count_scope (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, count_plan_id, location_id, gate_epoch, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{planId}, #{locationId}, #{gateEpoch}, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO count_line (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, count_plan_id, balance_id, location_id, snapshot_version, snapshot_qty, reserved_qty, counted_qty, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{planId}, #{balanceId}, #{locationId}, #{snapshotVersion}, #{snapshotQty}, #{reservedQty}, NULL, #{status}, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO count_observation (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, count_plan_id, count_line_id, observation_id, qty, actor_id, round_no, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{planId}, #{lineId}, #{observationId}, #{qty}, #{actorId}, #{roundNo}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id

INSERT INTO count_observation_serial (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, observation_id, normalized_serial, serial_id, presence_code, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{observationId}, #{serial}, #{serialId}, #{presence}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.update: UPDATE count_observation SET observation_kind=#{kind},serial_input_json=CAST(#{input,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSON) WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND observation_id=#{observation} AND observation_kind IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(round_no),0) FROM count_observation WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND count_line_id=#{line}
SELECT s.serial_enabled FROM stock_balance b JOIN sku s ON s.enterprise_id=b.enterprise_id AND s.id=b.sku_id WHERE b.enterprise_id=#{e} AND b.warehouse_id=#{w} AND b.id=#{balance}

SELECT serial_id,state,owner_epoch,sku_id,lot_id FROM local_serial WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND balance_id=#{balance} AND state IN ('AUTHORIZED','HOLD_RECEIVED','EXCEPTION','RECEIVING') ORDER BY serial_id LIMIT 201 FOR UPDATE
